newsitem.title: UK: BFI fall again as Panamax weakness continues.
newsitem.headline: BFI fall again as Panamax weakness continues.

text.p: The Baltic Freight Index (BFI) was down 16 points on Friday to 1,345 points.
Brokers said falling rates for Panaamxes continued to influence the index with brokers reporting especially weak condiitons for these vessels in the Pacific.
In the Atlantic Dreyfus booked Alpha Gemini for 54,000 heavy grain Santos to Taiwan for prompt shipment at a weak $24.25 basis 5,000 load or $22.50 basis 10,000 load.
Another poor fixture for owners was 65,000/10 coal Mobile to Rotterdam by Drummond for end April/early May at only $6.60.
At 1300 GMT BIFEX was 10 points lower to five points higher and turnover totalled 35 lots.
